full_prompt_en: A square landscape photograph looks across a succession of rolling cultivated hills in cool early morning haze. In the foreground, tall ripe grain forms broad, warm amber bands that curve in from the lower left, sweep around a deep blue-black shadowed patch on the right, and bend back toward a distant ridge. Dark parallel tracks cut through the grain, repeating the same generous S shape at a smaller scale. A lone person appears as a tiny dark silhouette near the middle of the picture, walking along the bright crest where warm grain meets the pale blue hillside. The person's features and clothing are indistinct at this distance; the small vertical mark chiefly provides a human measure for the open terrain. Behind, long smooth slopes rise and fall in layers of muted blue-gray. Fine, almost parallel rows of cultivation are visible where low light glances across their surfaces. A small rounded tree sits alone on a far ridgeline just left of center. The upper portion of the image is mostly pale blue mist and a faint sky without dramatic clouds, giving the field curves room to breathe. Low, oblique sunlight skims the wheat from the left and turns the crests pinkish gold, while the furrows and hollow on the right remain dark teal. Atmospheric moisture softens the distant hills, so their edges dissolve gradually instead of cutting sharply against the sky. The image has a quiet photographic finish with fine vegetation texture in the foreground and broad smooth tonal masses in the distance. Its rhythm comes from repeating curved agricultural lines, an isolated tree, and one nearly anonymous walker. The result feels spacious and contemplative, with fragile warmth held inside a larger cool landscape.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形风景摄影望向清晨薄雾中层层起伏的耕作山丘。前景成熟高谷物形成宽阔的暖琥珀色带，从左下弯入，绕过右侧深蓝黑色阴影地块，再折向远处山脊。深色平行田间轨迹切过谷物，以更小尺度重复宽缓的 S 形。一人以极小深色剪影出现在画面中部附近，沿着暖色谷地与淡蓝山坡相交的明亮脊线前行。相隔如此远，人物五官和衣着无法辨明；这道细小的竖线主要为开阔地形提供人的尺度。后方漫长光滑的山坡在低饱和蓝灰色中层层升降。低角度光掠过地面时，几乎平行的细密耕作纹路依稀可见。中央略偏左的一条远山脊上立着一棵小而圆的孤树。画面上部主要是淡蓝雾气和没有戏剧性云朵的微弱天空，让田地曲线保有呼吸空间。低斜阳光从左侧掠过麦穗，使山脊变成淡粉金色，而犁沟和右侧凹地仍是深青色。空气中的水汽柔化远丘，使边缘渐渐融解，而非锐利地切开天空。图像是安静的摄影质感，前景有细密植物纹理，远方则是宽阔平滑的明度块。它的节奏来自重复的弯曲农田线、一棵孤树和一位几乎匿名的行人。最终画面宽阔而沉思，在更大的冷色地貌中托住一缕脆弱暖意。
style_prompt_en: Atmospheric landscape photography reduces an expansive place to rolling tonal planes and a few carefully spaced scale marks. Long cultivated or natural striations follow the contours of hills, generating repeated S curves that lead from a textured foreground into faint distance. Cool blue-gray and dark teal occupy most of the frame, while low slanting light brushes narrow ridges with restrained amber and rose-gold. Haze lowers contrast gradually toward the horizon, dissolving edges without erasing the geometry of the land. Foreground grain or grass retains fine tactile detail; farther slopes become smooth broad masses. A very small dark vertical accent can make the scale legible without taking over the composition. Spacious sky, sparse forms, and long shadow bands establish stillness. The visual appeal depends on the balance of precise curved lines, soft atmospheric recession, and a limited warm-cool palette.
style_prompt_zh: 富空气感的风景摄影把辽阔场地归纳为起伏的明度平面和少量经过安排的尺度标记。漫长的耕作纹线或自然条纹顺着丘陵轮廓，形成重复的 S 曲线，引导视线从有肌理的前景走向朦胧远方。冷蓝灰与深青占据大部分画面，低斜光只用克制的琥珀与玫瑰金轻扫狭窄山脊。薄雾向地平线逐渐降低对比，使边缘融解，却仍保留地形几何。前景谷物或草丛保有细密可触的细节，远坡则化作平滑宽阔的色块。一处极小的深色竖向重音能让尺度可读，却不占据构图。宽裕天空、稀疏形体与长阴影带建立静止感。视觉魅力依靠精确的曲线、柔和的大气递进和有限冷暖色盘之间的平衡。
theme_en: A lone walker crosses bands of wheat on misty rolling hills
theme_zh: 一名孤独行人穿过薄雾起伏山丘上的麦田曲带
name: Marcin Sobas
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
